subject: Programming and Web Development Shop Profile
overview: Teacher Mrs. Miller and students present an overview of the Medford Vocational Technical High School Programming and Web Development shop, discussing its curriculum, hands-on projects, and classroom culture.

items.title: Shop Overview and Student Experience
items.summary: Teacher Mrs. Miller and student Saini introduce the shop, highlighting its focus on problem-solving, creativity, and building apps and websites with code.

items.title: Curriculum and Technical Skills
items.summary: Mrs. Miller outlines the programming languages taught in the shop, including Python, Java, C Sharp, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, while student George Toufas emphasizes teamwork.

items.title: District Website Project and Shop Community
items.summary: Mrs. Miller highlights the creation of the district website, and student Billy Toufas describes the supportive classroom environment and teacher guidance.

items.title: Post-Graduation Pathways
items.summary: Student Kouyate shares plans to study computer science and pursue game coding in college using the skills learned in the program.
